description: Angular component for managing Trendz settings in the Thingsboard UI, including form handling, validation, and saving settings via service.

classes.name: TrendzSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for configuring Trendz settings, including form validation and persistence.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form, loads existing settings, and sets up value change subscriptions.

methods.name: toggleUrlRequired
methods.description: Adds or removes the required validator on the trendzUrl control based on whether Trendz is enabled.

methods.name: setTrendzSettings
methods.description: Populates the form with provided Trendz settings.

methods.name: confirmForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for confirmation purposes.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current form settings via the service and updates the store.
